body.html: A thoughtful gift suits its giver and the recipient’s life. With luggage tags and keyrings, shape, material colour, branding and packaging make the difference. We develop personal one-offs, very small runs and larger gift projects with the same care, entirely around your requirements and handmade in the EU.
A useful travel companion carrying your brand identity. With a covered business-card window and personalisation coordinated with the material and colour.

media.alt: Luggage tag with branded leather and a buckle — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: A compact gift for everyday use. Coordinate its material and finish with luggage tags or other gifts to create a consistent collection.

media.alt: Leather keyring in a presentation box — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.
Find individual models, material choices and specification options in our complete accessory collection.
